scope: Uncommitted, display-only close-up prototype; no simulator, reward, action, scenario or trajectory changes

registration.local_cross_check: eval/validate_terrain_controls.py: sample() locates raster cell centres using half-cell offsets
registration.issue_found: Using cell-centre heights at ArcGrid corner coordinates shifts terrain sampling 12.5 metres along each axis
registration.remedy: Interpolate each domain-aligned display vertex from its four surrounding validated 25 metre cell-centre heights; retain the complete source halo

terrain.limitations: 50 metre display interpolation is not new measured detail. Source survey edition and exact vertical realization remain unverified. Unsupported terrain outside the validated domain is not rendered.

imagery.quality_gate: A 3072-pixel full-domain capture timed out during browser testing; use a smaller bounded viewport rather than inventing sharper imagery
imagery.registration: OpenLayers native EPSG:25830 viewport extent mapped directly to terrain UVs
imagery.retrieval: One bounded on-demand interactive source-map capture, normal browser tile requests/cache; no bulk archive, AI map texture or training-image export
imagery.street_fallback: Only when explicitly selected or an aerial tile fails
imagery.limitations: More display pixels do not establish provider ground resolution, live sensing or incident-era imagery. No individual trees or building geometry is inferred from photographs.

illustrative_overlays.inputs: Received public observation at the selected replay frame only
illustrative_overlays.labels: Screen-sized decluttering without changing source coordinates
not_measurements: Flame or smoke height, density, intensity and shape
Fine fire perimeter or sub-cell spread
Aircraft display altitude and enlarged vehicle/building symbols
Historical town population or building placement; exercise groups remain synthetic

validation.independent_review: Three issues corrected and rechecked: uncleared duplicate report handling, camera-depth label sizing, near-vertical top-down preset. Independent planar-height fixture confirms centre-to-corner interpolation.
validation.browser: Live pinned mesh371x361 verified. Official2048-pixel aerial capture rendered. Oblique/top-down, public61-frame replay, play/pause and below-map footer checked; no browser console errors observed.
validation.performance_scope: One development replay, not a40-fire-cell stress benchmark. First GPU draw required shader/texture warmup; later paused redraws were below1ms in the JavaScript render callback, which is not total GPU frame time.

publication_status: Prototype pending user visual review; do not commit or publish without approval
